archetypes.name: dyn-oos-routing
archetypes.rationale: OOS flow now spans vote tally, accepted sinks, and issue filing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed OOS routing from ballot tally through accepted sinks and issue preparation. Check that rejected or neutral OOS cannot reach filed sinks, while vote-accepted non-security OOS still files as a unified issue. Pay special attention to aggregate-pool interactions in both implement and design paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
